# Engine views: one node per enabled reviewer in the terminal UI and the web run page, per-reviewer retry and logs

## What to build

Already in the codebase (earlier slice): `packages/graph-execution/src/review/reviewers.ts` exports `type Reviewer` (`id`, `type: "diff"|"tester"`, `name`, …), `BUILTIN_REVIEWERS` (`code` named "Code review", `tester` named "Live test"), `readRunReviewers(runDir)` (the run's enabled reviewers from `<runDir>/reviewers.json`, else the built-ins), `RUN_REVIEWERS_FILE`, `notPerformed(r)` (`code review not performed`, `live test not performed`, `<name> not performed`), `reviewerAgent(id)` (`code` → `"reviewer"`, else the id, so `tester` → `"tester"`), `reviewerNode(id)` (`code` → `"@reviewer"`, else `@<id>`). `runner/events.ts` has `PipelineAgent = "reviewer"|"tester"|"fixer"|"gateFixer"` and `ReviewAgent = PipelineAgent | (string & {})`; the review phase emits `agent:start/retry/end` with `agent: reviewerAgent(id)` and label `<id>-r<N>` for every reviewer. `runner/nodes.ts` exports `agentNode(agent)`. `RunStore.setAgent` currently **ignores** agents that are not pipeline agents, so a `security` reviewer runs but has no node.

This slice gives every enabled reviewer its own node, everywhere the run is shown (spec `docs/prd/ui-reviewers.md`, "Engine: views"; KAN-87):
- The terminal UI (Ink and plain) and the web run page (`GET /state` → `graph.nodes`, built from `graphModel`) show one node per enabled reviewer, id `reviewerNode(id)`, titled with its `name`, in the reviewers' layer between the gate (or gate fixer) and the fixer. With the built-in list (no reviewers file) the nodes, ids, titles and layers are exactly today's: `@reviewer` "code reviewer" and `@tester` "live tester".
- No enabled reviewer: no reviewer node; the fixer hangs below the gate.
- A failed reviewer node can be retried (`POST /retry/@security` on the web page, the TUI retry keys) like `@reviewer`/`@tester` today.
- The Logs tab and the log tail match any `<id>-r<N>` label for `@<id>`.
- The final summary names reports by the reviewer's name.
- The suite page is unchanged.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/store.ts`:
  - lines 79-114 `REVIEW_AGENTS`, `ViewState` (`agents: Record<PipelineAgent, NodeView>`), `RunStoreOptions`;
  - lines 136-152 constructor initial `agents`; 158-170 `nodeChanges` and `review:end` (tester testPlan → `setAgent("tester", …)`); 182-190 `agent:*` handlers; 206-228 `run:restart` reset (lists the four agents); 229-245 `run:end` settle (only fixer/gateFixer); 281-283 `setAgent`; 301-313 `failedNodeIds` (fixed list of pipeline nodes).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/store.test.ts` (the existing expectations, e.g. line 210 `failedNodeIds(...)` → `["3", "@tester", "@merge"]`, line 47 `agents.tester.testPlan`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/model.ts` (whole file, 72 lines) — `AGENT_TITLE`, `graphModel` (layers `[AGENT_NODE.reviewer, AGENT_NODE.tester]`, parents of `@fixer`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/Graph.tsx` lines 55-70, `ui/App.tsx` line 253 (titles from `graphModel`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/start.tsx` lines 82-84 (`new RunStore(...)` when no store is given), 130-137 `NODE_LABELS`, 154-161 plain-mode `agent:*` lines.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/Summary.tsx` lines 18-35 (`REVIEWER_NAME`), 73.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/events.ts` lines 78-95 `RunEnd`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts`: 104-110 `NODE_TITLE`; 255-290 `execute` (`readRunReviewers`, `nodeTitle`, `new RunStore(events, { taskIds, merged, attempts })` at ~284); 316-340 `runEnd(...)`; 361-379 `opts.ui?.({...})`; 556-576 `retryTargets` (`id === AGENT_NODE.reviewer ? "code" : id === AGENT_NODE.tester ? "tester" : undefined`); 590-602 `prepareRetry`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/server.ts` lines 138-157 `snapshot()` (uses `graphModel`), 432-439 `retryRoute` (node must exist in `graphModel`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/logtail.ts` lines 24-35 `labelsForNode`; `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/logs.js` lines 9-20 (must stay identical in behaviour; `web/assets/logs.test.ts` line 13 compares both for a list of ids — add `@security` to that list).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/runpage.js` — renders `s.graph.nodes` generically (no change expected; check that nothing hard-codes `@reviewer`/`@tester`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/failure-summary.ts` — failure summaries use `nodeTitle`.
- Tests: `ui/store.test.ts`, `ui/App.test.tsx` (lines 10-50, 120-140), `ui/Graph.test.ts`, `web/server.test.ts` lines 70-100 (`body.graph.layers` equals `[["a"], ["b"], ["@gate"], ["@reviewer", "@tester"], ["@fixer"], ["@merge"]]`), `runner/run-retry.test.ts` lines 100-130 ("retries a tester that gave up").

## Patterns to follow

```ts
// The graph model is the single source for TUI and web nodes (ui/model.ts):
nodes.set(AGENT_NODE[agent], { title: AGENT_TITLE[agent], view: state.agents[agent] });
// web/server.ts snapshot(): graph: { nodes: [...model.nodes].map(([id, n]) => ({ id, title: n.title, view: n.view })), layers, parents }
```
Keep `ViewState` JSON-serializable (it is sent as-is by `GET /state` and cached by graph-manager).

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/store.ts`

- `RunStoreOptions`: add `/** The run's enabled reviewers, in order; the built-ins when omitted. */ reviewers?: readonly { id: string; name: string }[];` and `/** True when they come from a reviewers file: nodes are titled with their names. */ customReviewers?: boolean;`
- `ViewState`: add `/** One entry per enabled reviewer, in order: its id, run-event agent key, node id and title. */ reviewers: { id: string; agent: string; node: string; title: string }[];` and widen `agents` to `Record<PipelineAgent, NodeView> & Record<string, NodeView>`; to satisfy `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, read an arbitrary agent with a helper `agentView(state, agent): NodeView | undefined`.
- Constructor: `reviewers` entries from `opts.reviewers ?? BUILTIN_REVIEWERS`: `agent = reviewerAgent(id)`, `node = reviewerNode(id)`, `title` = `customReviewers ? name : id === "code" ? "code reviewer" : id === "tester" ? "live tester" : name`. Initial `agents` keeps the four pipeline agents (labels unchanged) and adds `{ status: "pending", attempt: 0, attempts, label: id }` for every other reviewer agent.
- `setAgent(agent, change)`: works for any key present in `agents` (still ignores unknown keys).
- `nodeChanges`: find the agent by `agentNode(agent) === nodeId` over all agent keys.
- `review:end`: set `testPlan` on the reviewer whose `type` is the tester — keep using the report with `reviewer === "tester"` (only the tester has cases).
- `run:restart`: reset every entry of `agents` (map over `Object.entries`).
- `failedNodeIds`: pipeline order gate, gate fixer, then every `state.reviewers` node (in order), then fixer, merge. With the built-ins this is today's order.
- **IMPORTS**: `{ BUILTIN_REVIEWERS, reviewerAgent, reviewerNode } from "../review/reviewers.js"`.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/model.ts`

- `GraphModelInput.state`: add `"reviewers"` to the `Pick`.
- `graphModel`: the reviewer layer is `state.reviewers.map((r) => r.node)`; nodes `{ title: r.title, view: state.agents[r.agent] }`; each reviewer's parents `[beforeReview]`; `@fixer`'s parents are the reviewer nodes, or `[beforeReview]` when there are none; omit the reviewer layer when empty. `AGENT_TITLE` keeps the four pipeline titles.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/start.tsx`

- `new RunStore(...)` (line 84): pass `reviewers`/`customReviewers` from new optional `UiOptions` fields `reviewers?: readonly { id: string; name: string }[]` and `customReviewers?: boolean`.
- Plain mode: `agent:*` lines use the title of the matching `store.getState().reviewers` entry (`reviewers.find((r) => r.agent === agent)?.title`), else `AGENT_TITLE`, else the agent string. `NODE_LABELS` lookups fall back to the reviewer title the same way.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/events.ts` and `ui/Summary.tsx`

- `RunEnd`: add `/** Reviewer id → name, for the summary; absent with the built-ins. */ reviewerNames?: Record<string, string>;`
- Summary.tsx: `const nameOf = (id: string, names?: Record<string,string>) => names?.[id] ?? REVIEWER_NAME[id] ?? id;` used where `REVIEWER_NAME[...]` is used (pass `end.reviewerNames` through the helpers that render the per-reviewer rows and findings). Built-in output unchanged.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts`

- `execute()`: `const custom = existsSync(path.join(ctx.runDir, RUN_REVIEWERS_FILE));` pass `{ reviewers, customReviewers: custom }` to `new RunStore(...)` and to `opts.ui?.({...})`.
- `nodeTitle(id)`: reviewer nodes get the store's titles (`view.getState().reviewers.find((r) => r.node === id)?.title`) before `NODE_TITLE`.
- `runEnd(...)`: add `...(custom ? { reviewerNames: Object.fromEntries(reviewers.map((r) => [r.id, r.name])) } : {})`.
- `retryTargets`: `const reviewer = reviewers.find((r) => reviewerNode(r.id) === id);` replaces the `@reviewer`/`@tester` test; the check reads `reviewReportPath(ctx.runDir, review.round, reviewer.id)` and `notPerformed(reviewer)`.
- `prepareRetry`: same lookup; removes that reviewer's report and its `review.reports[reviewer.id]` entry, as today for code/tester.
- **GOTCHA**: shared file with other suite features; change only these spots.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/web/logtail.ts` and `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/logs.js` (identically)

- After the `own` map: for a node id starting with `@` that is not in `own` and not `@gate`, `@merge` or `@human`, match `^<escaped id without @>-r\d+$`. Keep `summary-<id>` matching. `@security` → `security-r0`, `security-r1`, `summary--security`.

### Tests

- `ui/store.test.ts`: with `reviewers: [{id:"code",name:"Code review"},{id:"security",name:"Security"}], customReviewers: true`: `state.reviewers` ids/nodes/titles (`Code review`, `Security`); `agent:start { agent: "security", label: "security-r0" }` → `agents.security.status === "running"`; `agent:end ok:false` → `failedNodeIds` contains `@security`; `run:restart` resets it. Default store: `state.reviewers` titles `code reviewer`, `live tester` (existing tests unchanged).
- `ui/model` (add to `ui/Graph.test.ts` or a new `ui/model.test.ts`): three reviewers → layer `["@reviewer","@tester","@security"]`, `@fixer` parents those three; none → no reviewer layer, `@fixer` parent `@gate`.
- `web/server.test.ts`: a store with a security reviewer → `GET /state` `graph.nodes` has `{ id: "@security", title: "Security" }` and the layers put it next to `@reviewer`/`@tester`; existing layer assertion (line 85) unchanged for the default store.
- `web/logtail.test.ts` + `web/assets/logs.test.ts`: `@security` → `["security-r0", "security-r1"]`, not `code-r0`; add `@security` to the js/ts parity list.
- `runner/run-retry.test.ts`: pattern of "retries a tester that gave up" with a reviewers file (`runReview`-style or a fixture file written to `.git/reviewers.json` and passed as `reviewersFile`) where `reviewer:security-r0` writes `"not json"` 3 times → `hub.whenWaiting()` contains `@security`; `hub.retryNode("@security")` → exit 0 and `reports/round0/security.json` valid.
- `ui/App.test.tsx`: an Ink frame with a security reviewer shows `─ Security ─`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Default run (no reviewers file): TUI frames, `GET /state` graph (ids, titles, layers) and summaries exactly as today; existing tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] With `code`, `tester`, `security`: the web run page and the TUI show a `Security` node (`@security`) next to the other reviewers, with live status and retries; the Ink graph draws it.
- [ ] A failed `@security` is offered for retry and `POST /retry/@security` re-runs only it.
- [ ] Logs tab of `@security` lists `security-r<N>.log`.
- [ ] Summary rows use reviewer names.
- [ ] The suite page is unchanged.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-execution -- store model Graph App server logtail logs run-retry Summary start
npm test
```
